insight.what: SpaceX IPO获3500亿美元认购，机构抢筹
insight.assets: 📈 SpaceX 股票 利好；📈 太空概念股 利好

news.title: 欧洲央行近三年来首次加息以应对战争推升的通胀
news.detail: 为应对中东冲突引发的通胀反弹，欧洲央行周四宣布将三大关键利率各上调25个基点，这是该行自2023年9月以来的首次加息。

insight.what: 欧央行三年来首次加息应对战争通胀
insight.assets: 📈 欧元 短线走强；📉 欧洲债券 承压
insight.chain: 加息（借钱成本上升）抑制欧洲经济需求，利空欧股（EPS预期下调），美元相对走强
insight.watch: 欧央行后续加息路径点阵图及通胀数据

news.title: Proposed Iran-U.S. deal would reopen Hormuz strait and lift oil sanctions, Iran state media says
news.detail: U.S. President Donald Trump said Thursday that the Strait of Hormuz would be reopened as soon as a deal is signed.

insight.what: 伊朗-美国协议传闻重开霍尔木兹海峡并解除石油制裁
insight.assets: 📉 原油 承压；📈 全球航运股 利好
insight.chain: 供应增加预期压低油价（WTI/布伦特），降低通胀压力，利好原油进口国货币（如日元）

news.title: Pirro's losses in Fed investigation should stay on the books, judge rules
news.detail: In a scathing ruling, Judge James Boasberg denied U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro's request to vacate his earlier orders.

insight.what: 法官裁定Pirro在美联储调查中的损失需保留记录
insight.assets: 📉 美联储信誉 承压；📈 美元 短线偏弱
insight.chain: 监管不确定性（政策风险）增加，可能削弱市场对美联储独立性信心，利空美债
insight.watch: 后续调查进展及美联储官员表态

news.title: SpaceX’s Gwynne Shotwell had IPO doubts for years, now she has a message for investors
news.detail: Gwynne Shotwell, long Elon Musk's second-in-command at SpaceX, spoke exclusively with CNBC ahead of her company's highly anticipated IPO.

insight.assets: 📈 SpaceX 股票 中性偏多

news.title: Small investors scrambled to get in on the SpaceX IPO, even as some believe the valuation is 'stupid'
news.detail: While SpaceX's IPO has caused alarm that it may be overvalued, some retail investors still want in.

insight.what: 散户争抢SpaceX IPO，部分认为估值'愚蠢'
insight.assets: 📈 SpaceX 股票 短期偏多；📉 科技成长股 分化
insight.chain: 散户情绪（FOMO）推动首日交易量，但高估值（P/S倍数）若盈利不及预期，回调风险（回撤）加大
